translations.title: Connect to Helix Core
translations.intro: Enter the server and user. Your password is not stored here — sign-in and SSL trust will be separate secure steps when the server requests them.
translations.formSubtitle: You can change these settings later.
translations.p4PathHint: Change the path and select “Find again” in the status above.
translations.p4ConfigHint: Optional config filename or path passed to p4 without reading it here.
translations.p4EnviroHint: Optional p4 environment file path passed to p4.
translations.connectionSuccessBody: The connection works. The next step is choosing a workspace.
translations.settingsWarning: Recent connections could not be loaded or saved.
translations.localeWarning: Some language files were ignored because they are invalid or incomplete.
translations.hintExecutable: Install p4 CLI or specify its path manually.
translations.hintAuth: Sign in to Helix Core and try again.
translations.errorTrust: The server certificate is not trusted yet.
translations.hintTrust: Confirm SSL trust and try again.
translations.errorPermission: You do not have permission for this operation.
translations.hintPermission: Check the user and server access.
translations.errorInvalidOutput: p4 returned an unknown response format.
translations.hintInvalidOutput: Check the p4 CLI version and technical details.
translations.errorSettings: The application settings could not be opened.
translations.hintSettings: Check access to the local settings folder.
translations.errorCommand: p4 could not connect to the server.
translations.hintCommand: Check the server address, network, and connection settings.
translations.noWorkspaces: No workspaces owned by this user were found.
translations.exitWorkspaceHint: Return to Connections without signing out of Helix Core. Your ticket stays active.
translations.globalGoToHint: Open a depot path (//...), workspace scope (ws://...), changelist (#42), job (job:query), or label (label:query). Shortcut: Ctrl+L.
translations.goToUnknown: Use a depot path, ws:// scope, changelist number, job:query, or label:query.
translations.jobsBody: Bounded server list of jobs with descriptions and status metadata.
translations.fixChangePrompt: Numbered changelist to fix this job
translations.fixConfirm: Attach this job to the changelist?
translations.unfixConfirm: Detach this job from the changelist?
translations.shelvesBody: Browse server-side shelves and preview selected files before unshelving.
translations.shelvesUnshelveSucceeded: Selected shelf files were restored to the workspace.
translations.labelsBody: Bounded server list of labels with owner and update metadata.
translations.labelSyncConfirm: Sync the workspace to this label?
translations.loadingChangesBody: Reading pending changelists and opened files from the server.
translations.emptyChangeBody: This changelist has no files opened in the selected workspace.
translations.selectFileBody: Choose an opened file to inspect it, move it, or view its diff.
translations.diffTruncated: The diff is large. Showing the first 2 MB.

translations.fileMoved: The file was moved to the selected changelist.
translations.shelfOnly: Files are stored on the shelf

translations.submitWarning: This writes the selected changes to the depot. The operation can fail if files require resolve or are out of date.
translations.markdownHint: Markdown formatting is supported. Web links open in your default browser.

translations.unshelveWarning: Shelved files will be copied into the workspace. Existing opened files may require resolve; writable unopened files will not be forcibly overwritten.
translations.unshelveSucceeded: The shelved files were restored to the workspace.

translations.emptyShelfDrop: No shelved files. Drag local files here to shelve them.
translations.diffLocalDepot: Local workspace compared with have revision

translations.unshelveFileSucceeded: The selected shelved file was copied to the workspace.

translations.deleteShelfWarning: This permanently deletes every server-side copy in this shelf. Local opened files are not changed.
translations.shelfFileDeleted: The selected file was deleted from the shelf.

translations.fileReverted: The local opened file was reverted.

translations.submitConflictExplanation: This changelist contains two independent versions: local opened files and a server shelf. Choose which version becomes the submitted revision.
translations.submitShelfOptionBody: Local opened files are moved to a new recovery changelist first, then the shelf is submitted.
translations.submitLocalDeleteOptionBody: Deletes the existing shelf, then submits local files. If submit fails, the old shelf cannot be restored.
translations.submitLocalUpdateOptionBody: Refreshes the shelf from all local files, removes it as required by Perforce, and submits local files. On failure, the refreshed shelf is recreated.
translations.submitShelfPreserved: The shelf was submitted. Local work was preserved in
translations.deleteAddedFilesHint: Saved preference. When off, revert removes the add action but keeps the file on disk.
translations.revertAfterShelf: Revert local files after updating the shelf

translations.allConflictsSkipped: No files were changed because every conflicting file was skipped.
translations.revertAllPreviewWarning: Review every file that the server reports before reverting the changelist.
translations.noRevertFiles: The changelist has no files that can be reverted.
translations.cliLogEmpty: No warnings or errors in this session.
translations.workspaceFilesBody: Server-backed file status for the current workspace.
translations.workspaceSearchHelp: Filters the files already loaded below.
translations.filesFiltersOptional: Optional — the whole project is shown
translations.workspaceNoFiles: No files are mapped into this workspace.

translations.hintConflict: Refresh the workspace, resolve conflicts, or clear the lock/open conflict.
translations.errorOffline: p4 could not reach the server.
translations.hintCancelled: The workspace was refreshed; retry the operation if needed.
translations.hintStale: Refresh the data and preview again before applying the change.
translations.hintPartialResult: Narrow the scope or filter and repeat the request.
translations.hintOffline: Check the server address, network connection, and VPN.
translations.workspaceSpecBody: Read-only client mapping and options from the server.
translations.workspaceEditConfirm: Update this client workspace specification on the server?

translations.workspaceRenameConfirm: Rename this client workspace and migrate its work-in-progress on the server?
translations.fileScopeHelp: Keep //... to show the whole workspace; narrow it only when needed.

translations.syncKeptWritableFiles: Update finished; local conflicts were kept.

translations.renameSucceeded: File renamed in the pending changelist.
